Excerpts of a real MediaWiki `action=parse` response for
`Bumblebee (G1)/toys` from tfwiki.net, recorded 11 November 2026. Prose
paragraphs and images were cut out; the toy lines and bullet fields are as
served, plus one invented line at the top (a figure with no year). Text from the
Transformers Wiki is CC BY-SA 3.0 (https://tfwiki.net). `robots_*.txt` are small
stand-ins (the real file is `User-agent: *` / `Disallow: /`); `missing.json` is
the shape of the API's error reply.
